_note: Scanner settings. Values marked 'scanner' are this tool's own TIGHTENING filters (the prompt gives no number); prompt values are copied, never loosened. Edit owner_* lists to enforce G11 (never buy the owner's own coins).
_note_smart_money: S3 via smart_money.py (Helius, read-only). On by default; only active when the Helius key exists and data/smart_wallets.json has tracked wallets, else S3 = UNKNOWN = 0. Prompt weights and the 0.75 bar are unchanged.
_note_multichain: 2026-09-25: FOMO manual-card chains (help.fomo.family: Solana, Base, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Monad, Robinhood Chain). Phantom autonomous = evm_chains_auto + Solana only. Sui = research only (no venue). EVM chains run after Solana, one at a time, through the shared limiter.
_note_scoring: scoring_mode 'prompt' = the prompt's rule (fixed weights, UNKNOWN = 0, decision confidence = min). 'renormalized' (missing factors excluded + explicit haircut) LOOSENS buying vs the prompt, so set it only after the owner approves the matching §2C wording (SCORING_NOTES.md). The 0.75 bar is unchanged either way.
_note_social: S4 via social_data.py (keyless). Reddit search RSS allows ~1 request per 10 s without a key, so calls are spaced 11 s and capped per scan (reddit_max_*).
